note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To do list', 'Help', user avatar

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; excludes the project name header which is user-defined
SSH key warning alert -- renders: fixed platform warning message and action buttons
Breadcrumbs -- renders: 'Projects' and project namespace/name (platform chrome reflecting the current context)

Project header controls -- renders: 'Star', 'Fork', 'Clone', 'Web IDE', 'Find file', 'Commits', 'Branches', 'Tags', 'Contributors', 'Graphs', 'Compare', 'New file', 'New directory', 'Upload file', 'New project'; excludes project title, description, and repository content
File browser table headers -- renders: 'Name', 'Last commit', 'Last update'; excludes file names, commit messages, and timestamps
